title: Run the preset-driven init pipeline (FSD Lite, agent rules, GitHub templates, review)

preset.description: Preset that determines each sub-generator's default configuration (buildPresetConfig). Recorded in toolkit.config.json; omitted: the recorded one (required when none is recorded)

frontend.description: Target frontend; 'generic' is a framework nx-archweave does not recognise (common FSD rules, no renamed layers); 'none' is a backend-only workspace (needs --backend; FSD is skipped). Recorded in toolkit.config.json; omitted: the recorded one (required when none is recorded)

backend.description: Backend app wiring: delegates app creation to the official @nx generators and wires shared-types, scope tags, and module-boundary constraints. 'none' leaves the workspace frontend-only. Omitted: toolkit.config.json's backend (add-backend records it), else none — no schema default, which would shadow the recorded one

locale.description: Generated content language, passed through to every enabled sub-generator and recorded in toolkit.config.json. Omitted: the recorded locale, else en (no schema default — Nx would apply it even when the flag is omitted and shadow the recorded value)

reviewProvider.description: Review provider when review is on. Omitted: toolkit.config.json's review.provider (unless --aiHosts changes the first host), else the first AI host's (Claude Code → claude, Codex → gpt, Cursor → cursor, Gemini CLI → gemini)

aiHosts.description: The AI coding tools the workspace is set up for: they decide the agent-rules files (Claude Code → CLAUDE.md; Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI → AGENTS.md) and the review provider default (the first one's). Recorded in toolkit.config.json. Default: Claude Code.

fsd.description: Toggle add-fsd-lite. Defaults to the preset's enablement (always on)

agentRules.description: Toggle add-agent-rules. Defaults to the preset's enablement (on)

githubTemplates.description: Toggle add-github-templates. Defaults to the preset's enablement (on)

review.description: Toggle add-review. Defaults to the preset's review.enabled default (quick-start: off, solo/team: on)

dryRun.description: Preview the full pipeline: zero writes, and the post-run validation callback never runs

project.description: The frontend app(s) the FSD section sets up, comma-separated (web,admin). Needed when the workspace has more than one frontend; each gets the rule and is recorded in toolkit.config.json's frontends

strict.description: Fail the run (non-zero exit) when a section aborts or is refused. Files the other sections wrote stay; the report lists them. Without it init always succeeds and reports

allowDirty.description: Run even when the working tree has uncommitted changes. The report then warns that restoring the files init modified also reverts those pre-existing changes. Used by create-nx-archweave, whose own plugin-install step dirties the fresh workspace right before init runs

applyEslint.description: Write the ESLint rules for real — the scope depConstraints into the root config (add-backend) and the archweave/fsd-boundaries rule into the frontend app's config (add-fsd-lite) — instead of printing report-only snippets. The create CLI passes this on workspaces it just created; leave it off to keep existing configs untouched

packageManager.description: Package manager of the workspace (default: detected from lockfiles, then the one recorded in toolkit.config.json, then pnpm). Recorded in toolkit.config.json.
